name: Spaces
author: Macarchy
description: Your Spaces, each with the apps open on it. Click one to go there.

design.label: Boxes
design.hint: A box around the current Space, every Space, all of them together, or none

maxIcons.label: Most app icons
maxIcons.hint: After this many, a Space shows how many more, such as +7. 0 shows them all

hideEmpty.label: Hide empty Spaces
hideEmpty.hint: The Space you are on always shows

names.label: Names
names.hint: In order, separated by commas, such as Web, Code, Chat. Blank ones keep their number
